thread:
Anya: quick sync — finalizing pricing page experiments. need a short checklist: FAQ tweaks, tier names, and the new cost estimator widget. who can own routing for leads from the calculator?
Jess: I can take FAQ copy edits. propose we add one-line clarifiers for "Dedicated" vs "Private" and an example use-case under each.
Mike: for tier names i'd like to avoid 'Pro/Enterprise' cliches. can we test 'Developer / Business / Platform' ? A/B with current names.
Sam: routing note — if calculator returns > $10k/mo estimate, route to AE queue. otherwise self-serve. also flag any data retention or compliance notes to sales.
Nate: embedding the calculator should be straightforward but we need the routing hook. can you give the exact rule? we can accept a POST to /lead-router with payload {"estimate": 12500, "tier": "Business"}.
Sam: exact rule: if estimate >= 10000 OR user selects "Request a demo" checkbox -> route to sales. else -> marketing nurture funnel. Also capture org_size and compliance_need.
Katie: add analytics: event = pricing_estimate_generated, props: estimate, selected_tier, timestamp, utm_source. We'll A/B instrument variant=alpha/variant for tier names and calc layout.
Anya: awesome. Jess, draft the FAQ lines and drop in this thread when ready. Mike, can you define the A/B hypothesis and primary metric?
Mike: hypothesis: 'Developer/Business/Platform' will increase trial signups from page by 8% vs baseline. primary: conversion-to-trial within 7 days. secondary: avg estimated price.
Jess: dropped draft below — short answers only:
- "What does Dedicated mean?" -> Dedicated = reserved GPU pools for steady traffic. predictable throughput, SLA-backed.
- "What is Private?" -> Private = your inference plane in a VPC or on-prem; full network isolation and KMS support.
- "How are estimates calculated?" -> Estimates combine throughput, chosen model profile, batch size, and expected token counts; use as planning guidance.
Anya: nice and concise. Nate — can you confirm embed constraints?
Nate: we need an iframe + postMessage integration. security: only allow origins from redwood.com and staging.redwood.test. backend needs to validate HMAC header. eng-bot: reminder — deploy checklist created: `PR #3245` for calculator UI, `PR #3246` for router service.
Sam: can we add a fallback rule: if router service is down, fallback to creating a lead in Salesforce with tag "pricing-calc-fallback"?
Nate: yes, will implement. fallback = fire webhook to /sfdc/createLead with minimal payload.
Katie: timeline? we need at least 2 weeks of data for initial A/B. suggest 4-week experiment window, with interim check at 7 days.
Anya: timeline works. owners: Jess (FAQ copy), Mike (A/B plan + metric tracking), Nate (embed + router), Sam (sales routing + SFDC), Katie (analytics). I'll schedule a 20min check-in Fri 9am PT. calendar invite incoming.
Jess: putting copy into the content doc now -> link: https://docs.redwood.com/pricing-experiments (draft).
Mike: quick note — for messaging, keep unit-economics language out of top-level FAQ. reserve that for a deeper 'How it works' accordion.
Anya: agree. keep top page simple. thanks all :rocket:
Katie: SGTM :+1:
Sam: I'll update the inbound routing SOP after we test the fallback.
Nate: starting implementation today, will tag PRs in the thread when ready.
eng-bot: CI passed for PR #3245 and #3246 — build 5892.
Anya: perfect — will follow up after the Fri sync with next steps and experiment docs.
